## Handoff B — Gameplay Logic

### Per-Mode Loop Summary

| Mode | Input | Scoring Event | Completion | Known Stubs | Backend Fields |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| basketball_h2h | Dribble/shoot/defend | OnBasketScored() | PlayerScore>=21 | None | mode_id, score, duration, completed, result_type, xp_candidate, shards_candidate, prq_delta_candidate |
| basketball_dunk | Approach/jump/trick timing | OnDunkAttempt() | AttemptsRemaining==0 | Judge rubric weights | same |
| basketball_3v3 | Team pass/shoot/defend | OnTeamScore() | TeamScore>=21 | AI teammate logic | same |
| karate_h2h | Strike/block/counter | OnStrike() | HP<=0 | Hit detection radius tuning | same |
| karate_endless | Strike/dodge | OnWaveComplete() | PlayerDeath | Wave difficulty curve | same |
| baseball | Swing timing | OnSwing() | Inning==9 && Outs==3 | Fielder AI routing | same |
| football | Route run/throw/kick | OnTouchdown()/OnPassComplete() | MatchTimer<=0 | WR route path AI | same |
| soccer | Dribble/pass/shoot | OnGoal()/OnShot() | MatchTimer<=0 | AI goalkeeper skill curve | same |
| golf | Aim/power/release | OnStroke()/OnHoleComplete() | CurrentHole>TotalHoles | Wind system | same |
| tennis | Serve/rally/aim | OnPointWon() | PlayerSets==2 | Ball trajectory curve | same |
| volleyball | Serve/bump/set/spike | OnSpike()/OnPoint() | Points>=25 | Block detection timing | same |
| surfing | Balance/carve/trick | OnWaveRidden()/OnWipeout() | WavesRidden>=5 | Wave generation system | same + wave_quality |
| skateboarding | Trick input timing | OnTrickLanded()/OnBail() | MatchTimer<=0 | Trick animation set | same + combo_peak |
| snowboarding | Gate/trick timing | OnGateCleared()/OnAirTrick() | FinishLine reached | Terrain physics | same + top_speed |
| gymnastics | Element timing | OnElementCompleted()/OnDeduction() | RoutineComplete | Judge panel logic | same + execution_score |
| brain_brawl | Answer selection | OnAnswerSubmitted() | QuestionsAttempted>=bank | Question bank (MOCK_DATA) | same + cognitive_score, streak_peak, category_scores |
| who_scene_it | Identify media | OnIdentificationSubmitted() | RoundsPlayed>=TotalRounds | Media CDN pipeline | same + rounds_played, correct, accuracy_pct |
| court_carnival | Shot attempt | OnShotAttempt() | StationsCompleted>=10 | Camera transition timing | same + route_score, shots_made, shots_attempted |
| market_browse | Browse/select | none | PlayerExits | None | none (non-game) |

### P1 Economy — DO NOT CHANGE
```
PRQ_WIN=2.0, PRQ_DRAW=0.5, PRQ_LOSS=0.2
SHARD_WIN=50, SHARD_DRAW=25, SHARD_LOSS=15
XP_CAP_PER_SESSION=500
Pacing 5% shard bonus at pacing_score>=75
MRI = ARV*0.40 + (100-ESI)*0.35 + Pacing*0.25
Mode weights: football=1.5, karate=1.4, basketball_3v3=1.3, basketball_h2h=1.2, volleyball=1.2,
              soccer=tennis=who_scene_it=1.1, surfing=1.05, most=1.0, golf=skateboarding=snowboarding=0.9
```
Economy candidates are computed in FELGameplayManager.cpp — session POST resolves final rewards.

### iOS Build Notes

```
Bundle ID:        com.finalevolutionlab.app
Min iOS:          16.0
Max draw calls:   800 / frame (iPhone 14 target)
Performance tier: Metal 3 preferred
Lighting:         Baked only (no Lumen on mobile)
Shadows:          Disabled or baked only
Reflections:      No SSR — use IBL probes
Water:            Mobile-safe shader only (MAP_VeniceBeachSurf)
Crowds:           Billboard cards / instanced static meshes (LOD 3+)
Particles:        Cap per-emitter; no CPU particle chains
PostProcess:      Bloom disabled; simple color grading only
```

## Handoff E — Movement Lab

### Education Sections (8)

| Section | Content | Source Type | UI Label Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| AnatomyExplorer | Interactive 3D anatomy nodes per body region | DemoSynthetic | **"EDUCATION DEMO"** |
| BiomechanicsDemo | Movement mechanics demonstrations | DemoSynthetic | **"EDUCATION DEMO"** |
| IAPCorsetViz | Diaphragm / pelvic floor / TVA / multifidus corset ring visualization | DemoSynthetic | **"EDUCATION DEMO"** |
| KineticLeakageViz | Force escape visualization at weak IAP joints | DemoSynthetic | **"EDUCATION DEMO"** |
| CorePelvisRibHipEducation | IAP tuck cue, Staggered V Stance, rear-leg internal rotation, ribcage depression | DemoSynthetic | **"EDUCATION DEMO"** |
| MovementSnackArea | 2-minute drill presentations | DemoSynthetic | **"EDUCATION DEMO"** |
| AssessmentQuiz | 3-question local quiz on IAP, kinetic leakage, stance | Local (education only) | None (not economy-gated) |
| WorkoutPlanLink | Link to athlete workout prescription | Requires VerifiedAssessment source | None if verified |

### Source Type Separation Rules

```
DemoSynthetic     → ALWAYS show "EDUCATION DEMO" in UI
                  → Never connect to PRQ score
                  → Never claim measured biomechanical finding

HealthKitReadiness → Show "HealthKit Readiness" badge
                   → Can inform readiness HUD only (not PRQ medical truth)

MeasuredPose       → Show "Measured Pose" badge
                   → Requires athlete-specific scan session in backend

MeasuredLumaOrARKit → Show "Measured (Luma/ARKit)" badge
                    → Requires Luma or ARKit scan session in backend

VerifiedAssessment → Show "Verified Assessment" badge
                   → Requires Antigravity/backend confirmation of source + confidence
                   → Only source eligible for athlete-specific findings
```

### Anatomy Nodes Seeded (all DemoSynthetic)

1. IAP Corset — Core region — "EDUCATION DEMO" label
2. Replace the Up with the Down (IAP tuck cue) — Core
3. Staggered V Stance — Pelvis
4. Rear-leg internal rotation (glute medius cue) — Hip
5. Ribcage depression on exhale — Ribcage
6. Kinetic leakage at collapsed IAP — KineticChain
7. Movement Snack: 2-min IAP activation drill — MovementSnack

### Movement Lab Backend Handoff

- `WorkoutPlanLink` fires: `POST /api/athlete/workout_plan_link { plan_id }`
- `AssessmentQuiz` results are **not** economy-eligible (local education only)
- All DemoSynthetic content must show "EDUCATION DEMO" label — do not imply biomechanical diagnosis
- Athlete-specific nodes (bIsAthleteSpecific=true) require VerifiedAssessment source before display
